implementation: Native Metal completion failures now retain original logical Queue error sinks through general commands, pure compute batching, timed subcommands and staged write_buffer; callback delivery occurs outside pending-command locks
classification: Existing access-revoked/device-removed codes retain device-loss path; other failures currently surface as Error::Internal

gates.routing: real clear and pure-compute commands preserve owner; injected completed failure reaches original owner even when another Device polls; callback reentry, scope capture and no duplicate delivery pass

limits: Injected completion failures are not physical GPU faults
OOM-specific classification and error-code coverage remain open
Raw MetalDevice submit/write_buffer APIs preserve existing signatures and have no logical error sink
No idle native removal notification, physical reset or non-Metal qualification
No performance qualification for added per-submission ownership tracking
Error-scope asynchronous pop semantics are outside this change
